Package org.cyclops.colossalchests2.api.block

Interface IChestMember

All Known Implementing Classes:
BlockChestFunctionalWall, BlockChestWall, ChestMemberBlock, GameTestAddon.Wall
public interface IChestMember
A block that can be part of a chest's shell in any material, such as a functional wall. Its block state needs FORMED, which the core sets. ChestMemberBlock does all of this.

  • Field Details

    • FORMED

      static final net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.BooleanProperty FORMED
      If the block is part of a formed chest. Formed members are drawn by the chest, so their formed model should be invisible.
